name: Caterpillar - Victoria TX Hydraulic Excavator Plant

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '203 Holt Rd' geocoded to the HOLT CAT dealership, NOT the Caterpillar manufacturing plant. Correct site is the ~1.1M sq ft Caterpillar North American Hydraulic Excavator plant at 7300 Lone Tree Rd, Victoria TX 77905, ~3.3 km WSW of the roster point, just SW of Victoria Regional Airport. Confirmed via Victoria Chamber of Commerce listing and the massive modern tilt-up building visible in satellite at 28.8195,-96.9375.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced manufacturing campus (chain-link perimeter fence visible in Street View). Truck operations enter via wide internal divided campus roads from Lone Tree Rd; a controlled truck check-in is consistent with a major Cat plant. No barrier arm positively imaged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively confirmed. The small SW structure (28.8163,-96.9384) is a windowless utility/electrical building, not a staffed booth. Marked guardShack false / remoteGs true on a remote-checkin assumption - low confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A row of dock doors with trailers backed in is visible along the SW building face in Street View; estimated 10-25 band from overhead/ground imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers and material laydown staged along the W/NW side of the plant; estimated 25-50 trailer-equivalent area.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main 1.1M sq ft plant building plus a second large building NW and a third smaller structure SW, two retention ponds, separate parking.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~161 acres for the developed/fenced campus; the property parcel including buffer land is larger.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; the rail line near the airport does not serve the plant.
